name: AWS IAM — Users
description: Pull IAM users as cloud identities for CIEM (Cloud Identity & Entitlement Management) analysis

steps.instruction: Log into the AWS Management Console and go to IAM → Users
Create or select an IAM user and attach the IAMReadOnlyAccess managed policy
Go to Security credentials → Create access key → Choose 'Third-party service'
IAM is global. Provide a region for SigV4 signing.

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to AWS IAM. Verify your access key has IAMReadOnlyAccess permission.

transform.expr: {'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'identity_type': 'iam_user', 'username': record.get('UserName', ''), 'user_id': record.get('UserId', ''), 'arn': record.get('Arn', ''), 'account_id': (str(record.get('Arn', '')).split(':')[4] if record.get('Arn') and len(str(record.get('Arn', '')).split(':')) > 4 else ''), 'display_name': record.get('UserName', '')}

{'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'resource_type': 'iam_user', 'identity_subtype': 'human', 'path': record.get('Path', '/'), 'create_date': record.get('CreateDate', ''), 'password_last_used': record.get('PasswordLastUsed', ''), 'has_console_access': bool(record.get('PasswordLastUsed')), 'permissions_boundary': (record.get('PermissionsBoundary', {}) or {}).get('PermissionsBoundaryArn', ''), 'tags': {t.get('Key', ''): t.get('Value', '') for t in (record.get('Tags') or [])}}

region.description: AWS region for SigV4 signing (IAM is a global service)
